beats: My feature demo clips looked close to the real product — but a redrawn screen isn't it.
Compared side by side against a real recording, the hand-drawn version was obviously the weaker copy.
So every interface beat plays a Playwright recording — commit history, live runs, the site itself.
The old built-in video capture drifted one-point-one times off the clock, walking narration off the picture.
Now it's one screenshot per frame — locked exactly to the voice, with zero drift.
